messages:
Oncall Bot: ALERT -> embeddings-service error rate crossed threshold (errors > 5% over 10m). Pager: Alex Chen. Incident ID INC-2026-89. https://ops.redwood/INC-2026-89
Incident Bot: automated runbook suggestion: scaling + fallback_model. See /runbooks/embeddings-rate-fallback

Alex Chen: taking primary for this shift, I'll own mitigation for next 4h. summary: sustained 5xxs from embeddings workers in us-west-2, p95 latency ~2-3x, errors mostly from requests routed to gpu-pool-b. Suspect redis throttling + recent routing change.

Alex Chen: current state / quick timeline:
- 16:02 PDT: first alert (errors spike)
- 16:08 PDT: autoscaler did not react quickly due to bursty requests
- 16:12 PDT: scaled embeddings-workers 3 -> 8 manually
- 16:20 PDT: enabled fallback_model=quantized-small for non-critical tenants
- 16:25 PDT: increased redis client retries to 5 (temp)

Alex Chen: mitigation commands I ran (for on-call reference):
```
# scale worker pool
kubectl scale deploy embeddings-workers -n prod --replicas=8
# toggle fallback model via admin API
curl -X POST "https://inframanager.internal/api/v1/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"fallback_model":"quantized-small","scope":"non-critical"}'
# increase redis client retries (config push)
curl -X POST "https://configpush.internal/services/embeddings" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"redis_retries":5}'
```

Priya Singh: I'll be secondary and will own customer comms and tracking support tickets. Noted ComposeAI hit timeouts, Support Bot has created ticket SUP-1342. I'll coordinate status updates.

Jamie Torres: ComposeAI reported bulk ingest jobs failing (ingest job 3212). They see 503s at client side and multiple retries. Impact: delays and duplicate attempts. I suggested temporary retry-backoff client change.

Alex Chen: open firing alerts to watch:
- prometheus: embeddings_request_errors_ratio > 0.05 (firing)
- prometheus: embeddings_p95_latency > 2000ms (firing)
- grafana panel: redis_throttle_rate > 0.2 (firing)
Links: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeddings /panel?orgId=1 (use internal network)

Dana Lopez: adding runbook pointer — if scaling and fallback don't reduce errors in 15m, rollback the routing change (rev: route-2026-04-11) that sent more traffic to gpu-pool-b. Rollback command below.

Dana Lopez: rollback snippet:
```
# rollback routing policy to previous revision
curl -X POST "https://router-admin.internal/v1/policies/route-override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"revision":"route-2026-04-10","force":true}'
# verify (expect routing table to show gpu-pool-a weight back to 80%)
curl "https://router-admin.internal/v1/policies/route-override" | jq .current
```

Alex Chen: temporary customer-impact note for handoff: about ~12 tenants saw elevated errors, 3 customers reported failures (ComposeAI highest priority, BetaDocs and NoteLab partial). We've opened pre-written status page draft; Priya will post if we escalate to page.

Priya Singh: I'll prepare a short status message for customers if we don't stabilize in the next 30m. Template ready: "We're investigating increased errors for embeddings in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; ETA 30-60m."

Support Bot: Ticket SUP-1342 created for ComposeAI (assigned: Priya Singh). Slack thread: #support-SUP-1342

Alex Chen: operational checklist for whoever is primary next:
- monitor the three firing prometheus alerts
- watch redis throttle metrics and client queue depth
- verify fallback_model traffic % (should be < 40% for non-critical tenants)
- prepare rollback of routing change if no improvement after scale
- maintain heartbeat with support (Priya) and engineering (Dana)

Alex Chen: notes on safety / customer risk:
- don't mass-restart all workers (that will reset caches and increase load on redis)
- if rolling restart necessary, do in small batches and monitor cache miss rate

Jamie Torres: FYI — I pushed a short query for failed request IDs to S3 logs, will attach to SUP-1342. Command: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://prod-logs/embeddings/2026-04-11/part-00012.gz - | zgrep "error 5.." | head -n 200
```

Dana Lopez: I'll take over primary at 17:30 PDT. Passing detailed notes to Dana. Alex -> Dana handoff: primary role transfer in 15m.

Alex Chen: handing off primary to Dana Lopez at 17:30 PDT. I'm keeping this thread open for 30m after handoff. Secondary remains Priya Singh.

Dana Lopez: ack, taking primary at 17:30. Plan after takeover: verify replicas and routing weights, watch for regressions for 20m, then consider rollback if no improvement.

Alex Chen: action items before stepping down:
- leave traces of commands used in incident doc (done)
- update INC-2026-89 with timeline and mitigations (I added notes)
- ensure support has customer status draft (Priya confirmed)

Priya Singh: confirmed. will post status if Dana asks.

Dana Lopez: will maintain the bridge and keep this thread active. If condition worsens, page eng-sre and infra leads (Alex if needed).

Alex Chen: passing primary now -> Dana Lopez (17:30 PDT). Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-89 updated: primary=Dana Lopez, secondary=Priya Singh, status=mitigating.

Dana Lopez: closing note for handoff message: I will triage for next 2h and escalate to oncall-manager after that if unresolved.
